subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the first Control UI calendar slice, or require the fuller daily/week/stats/drag-drop design before implementation continues?
rationale: The request adds new Control UI product surface, and the open linked PR implements only part of the requested visualization while needing a current-main rebase and correctness work.

options.title: Repair narrow timeline first
options.body: Use the linked PR or a fresh branch to add a current-UI 24-hour timeline while tracking daily/week/stats/drag-drop behavior separately.

options.title: Design full calendar scope
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define the daily, weekly, stats, drag-and-drop, and validator behavior as one cohesive feature.

options.title: Defer core calendar view
options.body: Keep the current list/run-history UI and close the linked implementation if maintainers decide this does not belong in near-term core Control UI.

recommendation.title: Repair narrow timeline first
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR or a fresh branch to add a current-UI 24-hour timeline while tracking daily/week/stats/drag-drop behavior separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a Control UI product-scope decision, and Peter has prior review context plus adjacent UI history.
